actions.description: Fence old primary, promote replica, switch proxy atomically
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib
D = pathlib.Path("/var/lib/failover")
def atomic_write(path, data):
    tmp = D / (path.name + ".tmp")
    fd = os.open(tmp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
    os.write(fd, data); os.fsync(fd); os.close(fd)
    os.replace(tmp, path)                      # atomic
    dfd = os.open(D, os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(dfd); os.close(dfd)  # durable dir entry
# 1. Durably fence the old primary BEFORE writes are restored
atomic_write(D / "primary.fenced", b"fenced\n")
# 2. Promote replica (atomic role flip)
atomic_write(D / "replica.role", b"primary\n")
# 3. Atomically switch proxy upstream to the promoted replica
atomic_write(D / "upstream", b"8082\n")
